about: Sources that GitHub's servers cannot open (they time out from abroad), with the day a person last read each one in a browser. The monthly check lists them under 'Sources read by hand' and leaves them out of its count while that reading is at most 120 days old; an older reading counts again. After reading a source and finding it still says the same, update its date here in a pull request. The dates below are the day the facts that use them were checked (lib/garden-visits.ts).
